id.description: Identifier of the Elementor document to summarize. Call elementor-document-list for the documents Elementor controls.

type.description: The WordPress post type: page, post, or elementor_library for a saved template.

status.description: The WordPress post status, such as publish or draft.

editMode.description: The stored Elementor edit mode, normally builder. Empty when the stored value is unreadable.

nodeCount.description: Every element on the page, at any depth.

maxDepth.description: How many levels deep the page nests. Zero for an empty document.

containerCount.description: Elements that hold other elements: sections, columns, containers, and any element whose stored data declares no type.

bandCount.description: Top-level elements, which is how many entries `bands` holds.

type.description: A widget type present on the page.

count.description: How many elements of this type the page holds, at any depth.

widgets.description: One entry per distinct widget type, most used first, ties broken by name. One entry per type, never per occurrence.

type.description: A container element type present on the page. The empty string counts elements whose stored data declares no type.

count.description: How many elements of this type the page holds, at any depth.

containers.description: One entry per distinct container type, most used first, ties broken by name.

index.description: The band's zero-based position in stored order, top of the page first.

id.description: The band's stored Elementor identifier, or null when its stored data declares none. A band with no identifier cannot be addressed by any write.

elType.description: The band's stored element type, or the empty string when it declares none.

label.description: A short display string derived from the type. Not stored, and never to be written back.

descendantCount.description: Every element inside this band at any depth, excluding the band itself. This is how much of the page a full read of this band would return.

widgetTypeCount.description: Distinct widget types within this band. When it exceeds the length of `widgetTypes`, that list was truncated.

widgetTypes.description: Distinct widget types within this band, alphabetically, at most 12. Enough to recognize the band, not to enumerate it.

bands.description: One entry per top-level element, in stored order.

untypedElements.description: Elements anywhere on the page whose stored data declares no type. They are read as containers, conservatively; this is the size of that assumption here.

unidentifiedElements.description: Elements anywhere on the page whose stored data declares no identifier. Every element write addresses its target by identifier, so this is how much of the page SiteHelm cannot change.
